TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_WEATHER_COMPASS.title: 候风仪
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_WEATHER_COMPASS.descrip: 每次观天时，抽1张牌，获得1点能量。
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_WEATHER_COMPASS.flavor: 不改变天空，也能找到方向。
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_CELESTIAL_COMPASS.title: 浑天候风仪
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_CELESTIAL_COMPASS.descr: 每次观天时，抽1张牌，获得1点能量。每次观天时，获得3点格挡。
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_JADE_DEW_CUP.title: Jade Dew Cup
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_JADE_DEW_CUP.descriptio: The first time you observe Yin each turn, gain 3 extra Block.
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_SUN_NEEDLE.title: Gnomon
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_SUN_NEEDLE.description: The first time you observe Yang each turn, deal 4 extra damage to that enemy.
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_SUN_NEEDLE.flavor: Measure the sun by its shadow.
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_THUNDER_BELL.title: Thunder Bell
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_THUNDER_BELL.descriptio: Every third observation in a combat deals 5 damage to all enemies.
TIAN_XIANG_RELIC_THUNDER_BELL.flavor: On the third peal, the valley answers.
